# Capabilities

What the running system can actually answer, so a caller can ask before it assumes.

```rux
pub struct Capabilities {
    pub unixPermissions: bool;
    pub creationTime: bool;
    // private fields
}
```

## Fields

| Name              | Type   | Description                                                                                     |
| ----------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `unixPermissions` | `bool` | Whether `Permissions::mode` is the system's own answer rather than one synthesized from a flag. |
| `creationTime`    | `bool` | Whether the system records a creation time.                                                     |
